data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/scripts/exempt-in-flight-prs.sh:
- gh pr list --state open --json number,headRefName,headRefOid
- For each PR: gh pr edit <num> --add-label migration-grace
- Append exemption record to docs/migration-exemptions/sub-pr-cutover.jsonl at repo root (NOT in event-sourced tracker — operational log, not ticket state).
- Idempotent: skip if label already present.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Script exists, shellcheck-clean
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/exempt-in-flight-prs.sh && shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/exempt-in-flight-prs.sh
- [ ] T6 passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-exempt-in-flight-prs.sh
data.title: S_mig.T7: IMPL exempt-in-flight-prs.sh (GREEN T6)
